items.quote: 18:7 And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.
items.claim: Abraham fetched a tender calf from the herd and gave it to a young man to prepare for eating
items.action: ran unto the herd, fetcht a calf, gave it unto a young man, hasted to dress it
